TeaNode is free and open source. You run the server yourself, on a computer you control, and this app signs in to it. There is nothing to buy and no TeaNode account to make.
A Linux computer you own or rent, or a Mac with Docker Desktop. The assistant needs no domain and no mail ports.
Run it on that computer. It installs Docker on Linux if it is missing, then starts TeaNode and its database.

Open http://127.0.0.1:8080 on that computer. The first person to open it creates the administrator account. Then choose the model service your agent thinks with, OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini or your own, and press Start my assistant.
This app signs in only over https. Put a reverse proxy with a certificate in front of port 8080, such as Caddy, nginx with Let\'s Encrypt, or a tunnel service, on a name such as teanode.example.com.
Go back and type that address, or open Settings, then Devices, then Connect a phone in the dashboard and scan its code.
